what: On first open a background-color curtain covers the screen with a spinner in the center (loops if a Lottie is given). Once the document has fully arrived, .5s later the spinner fades out in .5s and 1s later the curtain fades out in .8s (jQuery fadeOut swing). At 1s fx:play fires (slot for playing the first video), and when fully cleared fx:done. If load does not arrive within 10 seconds, it clears in the same order then

options.src: Spinner Lottie — JSON URL or ”#id” (in the document <script type="application/json"> — a page opened via file:// can’t receive the address). If missing, [data-fx-part=Same picture as inside spinner]
options.spin-delay · spin-fade: When the spinner starts to disappear after load · duration (s), default .5 · .5
options.delay · fade: Start time·length (seconds) of the curtain lifting after load, default 1 · .8 — shorten for screens that are passed often
options.play: When fx:play fires after load (sec), default 1

note: With reduced motion, hide the curtain from the start and fire fx:play and fx:done right away

from.where: index.html #pl-loading (concentric ring Lottie 50fps 3s, first video plays after 1s)
